name: 48085 · Troy, MI
findings: ZIP 48085 (Troy) has 102 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48085 (Troy) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48085 (Troy) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 45 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 10 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
